title: Pecan Cake
desc: Dark, acid-etched concrete surfaces absorb cool daylight streaming through an expansive loft window. A dense, velvet-moist date cake studded with roasted pecans rests atop an artisanal ceramic plate, as a thick stream of rich brown butter toffee syrup slowly drapes over its textured crown.
businessBrief: The rich contrast between the dark industrial surface and the warm, glossy caramel drip establishes an ultra-premium aesthetic. Perfect for luxury dessert brands, high-end pastry shops, and CPG caramel or syrup manufacturers seeking an elevated, moody visual identity.
